history.summary: A freehold 1,755 sqft 3BR at Venezio, a small 40-unit D16 (Upper East Coast) development built 2006, at $2.7M / $1,538 psf. Freehold and the TEL Bayshore catalyst are positives, but the 14.1%/yr rate is meaningless on 4 txns and the 40-unit scale + $2.7M quantum mean thin liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Web research confirms Venezio is a 40-unit freehold block (built 2006) with recent transactions around $1,515 psf — the listing's $1,538 psf is right at market. The headline 14.1%/yr appreciation is a statistical artefact of just 4 transactions and must be disregarded. The real case is: freehold land in Upper East Coast, ~580m to the upcoming Bayshore MRT (TEL) — a genuine catalyst, and the Bayshore precinct redevelopment nearby. Against that: a 40-unit boutique (thin liquidity, no facilities of scale), an oversized 1,755 sqft 3BR, and a $2.7M quantum above the deep buyer band. Balanced to Neutral; the TEL/Bayshore upside is real but the format and quantum cap liquidity.
